decision: Retain raw book size, outer funding rate, nested funding rate and funding interval separately. No capacity, rate-scale conversion or projected funding is justified by this follow-up.

explicit_distinctions.bound: This does not specify whether the REST string encodes 0.1 or 0.001 for that rate.
explicit_distinctions.fact: The US help example uses a +0.1% hourly rate. In arithmetic, 0.1% equals a decimal fraction of 0.001.

explicit_distinctions.bound: No inference from funding_interval to account posting frequency is supported.
explicit_distinctions.fact: US funding is calculated hourly; clearing aggregates cash adjustments at margin runs, and FCM posting may occur once or twice daily.
explicit_distinctions.kind: hourly rate calculation versus cash posting

explicit_distinctions.bound: It does not explicitly identify CDE units or map new_quantity to REST L2Level.size.
explicit_distinctions.fact: The Spot/US level2 reference describes new_quantity as the whole updated level size rather than a delta, with zero removing the level.
explicit_distinctions.kind: WebSocket quantity semantics versus REST quantity units

explicit_distinctions.bound: Native CDE FIX/SBE, Global/INTX or Deribit definitions are not substituted into REST fields without an explicit mapping.
explicit_distinctions.fact: The current endpoint overview separates Spot/US and Global streams, and the US guide identifies CFM products.
